statements.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has received quite a lot of attention lately, and I'm proud to see it. [...] I've also been working with our partners in the private industry, including Alex Wang (Scale AI), Alex Karp (Palantir), and Josh Lospinoso (Shift5) to ensure we're putting guardrails in place to effectively regulate and protect our development of AI for national security usage.
statements.context: Senate Armed Services Committee hearing on the FY 2024 budget request and the U.S.-China relationship, in a written question for the record submitted to administration witnesses.

statements.text: But we have just positioned ourselves for greater artificial intelligence, infrastructure growth [...] We have attracted several significant investments, like Amazon Web Services, the hyper-skilled data centers from many major companies that we are excited about, but, of course, what is crucial for supporting fast-growing AI is reliable energy and affordable energy.
statements.context: Senate hearing on the Department of Energy's FY 2026 budget request, where Senator Hyde-Smith highlights Mississippi's AI infrastructure investments before questioning the Secretary.
